issues.legal_issue: A tenant who delivers possession after the deadline specified in a rebuilding eviction decree cannot obtain reoccupation under the statutory remedy for tenants displaced for rebuilding.
material_facts: The landlords brought eviction suits on the ground that the premises were bona fide required for rebuilding.
The compromise decrees required the tenants to deliver possession by a specified date and provided for their return after rebuilding; the tenants elected to return.
The tenants delivered possession after the specified date, the landlords rebuilt the premises, and the tenants then applied to be put back into possession.
issues.conclusion: Because the tenants did not deliver possession on or before the dates specified in the decrees, they could not use the statutory reoccupation remedy and were not entitled to be put back into possession under it.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 13(1), proviso (g), and 15 of the Delhi and Ajmer Rent Control Act, 1952 governed the eviction for rebuilding and the tenant’s election and possible reoccupation. Under section 15(3), the remedy depended on the tenant delivering possession on or before the date specified in the decree or order. The compromise decrees were substantially in accordance with section 15, and the applications for return were in substance applications under section 15(3). The Court cited no earlier cases.

rule.if: rebuilding_eviction_case and decree_specified_delivery_deadline and tenant_elected_return and tenant_delivered_possession_late

predicates.rebuilding_eviction_case: A landlord brought an eviction proceeding because the premises were required for rebuilding.
predicates.decree_specified_delivery_deadline: The decree stated a deadline by which the tenant had to deliver possession to the landlord.
predicates.tenant_elected_return: The tenant elected to return to the premises after rebuilding.
predicates.tenant_delivered_possession_late: The tenant delivered possession to the landlord after the deadline stated in the decree.

issues.definition: If a rebuilding eviction case has a decree specifying a delivery deadline, the tenant elected to return, and the tenant delivered possession late, the tenant is not entitled to reoccupation under the statutory remedy.
